title.narrative: CAFOD Community Based Green Energy Project (CB-GEP)

description.narrative:
The Community Based Green Energy Project (CB-GEP) is a 4 year programme which begun in 2011 and is expected to end in 2015. The programme overall aim is to contribute towards increasing access to modern, affordable and sustainable energy services for 407,792 households through 138 schools and health centres and 69 rural community based groups in rural and peri-urban areas in Kenya.
The programme is being implemented in three counties; Kitui, Isiolo and Kajiado County in Kenya. Partners involved in the programme are; Dupoto-E-Maa, Catholic Dioceses of Isiolo and Kitui and Solar Works East Africa Limited which is a private Sector Company focusing on Solar Energy Technology and operating in East Africa.
The programme has 4 key specific and closely interrelated objectives these are: 1. To improve provision of energy services for schools and health centres in rural and peri-urban areas in target districts. 2. To increase local incomes for rural and peri-urban youth and women groups through installation of off-grid information and communication technology (ICT) centres in rural townships that will be incorporate cyber cafes, computer training and related services. 3. To improve management of natural resources by target rural and peri-urban communities through providing alternatives to crude sources of energy such as wood fuel, kerosene and charcoal through installation of solar water pumping systems at existing water structures, support for solar lighting systems for schools and health centres, use of energy saving jikos and community awareness raising on environmental protection. 4. To build local capacities of partners and target communities for implementing and managing modern energy systems. This is being achieved through engaging Solar Works E.A Limited to train local partners, students and staff at schools and health centres, and community groups’ members on maintenance of energy systems and creation of awareness of the target beneficiaries on how to maintain and ensure safety of the energy systems.
CAFOD will support in the following activities during the remaining period of implementation:
• Organise annual partner cross learning exchange visits of 4 days for 15 pax • Organise annual partner project review and planning meeting for 25 pax for 3 days • Facilitated CBA Training workshop for 4 days @ 25 pax • Facilitated an End Term Evaluation • Carry out project audit • Project monitoring • Carry out purchases of visibility materials for the three project sites
